description: Skill retrieval over IronStone BOSS's skills (skill/), run with no model (moqui test mr-boss --skills). Each case: the query (a message as a user writes it), an optional page, the skills one of which must be in the top three (expect), and skills that must not match strongly (negatives).

draft an answer to Joe's ticket
write back to the customer about the late filters
give me a recap of the ticket before I hand it over
why is this store not ready to go live
explain the readiness findings of the shop
why did this cart not convert
is this customer's basket abandoned or stuck at checkout
why did the marketplace orders fail to import
should I retry the failed channel messages
what does a quarantined conflict on the integration mean
add a new user account for our new buyer
invite Maria to the Retail organization as a purchasing buyer
resend Tom's invitation, he lost the email
